title: Blueberry Caramelized Canadian Skillet
description: A sweet and savory breakfast dish made with caramelized Canadian bacon, blueberries, and a hint of yellowed butter. Perfect for a weekend brunch.
instructions: Cook Canadian bacon in a skillet over medium heat until caramelized, flipping halfway through.
Add blueberries to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they start to release their juice.
Add yellowed butter to the skillet and stir until melted.
Serve the Canadian bacon and blueberries in the skillet, garnished with additional blueberries if desired.
Cook to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C) for Canadian bacon.
